Open a site that Cloudflare is refusing, and pass its check yourself

Some sites put a Cloudflare check in front of themselves. Animato tries to pass it invisibly and cannot when the check wants you to tap a box — nothing invisible can tap anything.\n\nOpen the site below and pass the check. Animato keeps the result and uses it everywhere afterwards, for both anime and manga.

Bring a library across from an Aniyomi backup

Animato does not upgrade over an existing Aniyomi install. Pick the file Aniyomi wrote — its name ends in .tachibk — and everything in it comes across: anime and manga, categories, history, tracking and settings. Importing again later is safe; nothing is deleted and progress is kept at whichever side got further.
